items.title: New digital courses for how to optimize AI compute and containers on AWS
items.summary: Two new AWS Skill Builder courses teach you how to match the right AWS compute to your AI workloads and boost Amazon EKS efficiency to improve both performance and cost. Learn to optimize AI hardware across the AI pipeline and maximize Amazon EKS with EKS Auto Mode, AWS Graviton, and Amazon EC2 Spot Instances.
items.creator: Sophy Chen
